name: Quake Bird
description: A flappy-style arcade game with optional shared high scores.

options.label: Player initials (optional)
options.help: Overrides the initials entered in the game. 1-3 letters (A-Z); scores are recorded under them on the shared high-score server (arcade style: same initials = same player).

options.label: Server URL (advanced)
options.help: Advanced: base URL of the shared score server. Clear it to play offline — your best then stays on this PC.
